Running Python code interactively: # Now I understand the structure. Let me build the PKCS12 properly.
# The key insight from the OpenSSL output:
# - The AuthenticatedSafe contains two ContentInfo elements
# - First: PKCS7 data with certificate bag 
# - Second: PKCS7 data with key bag
# The SafeBag for key bag has OID 1.2.840.113549.1.12.10.1.1 and bagValue is PKCS8 PrivateKeyInfo
# 
# For the vulnerability, I need:
# 1. A working key bag (so the first loop succeeds and sets privkey_ok=1)
# 2. A CRL bag with invalid CRL data (so gnutls_x509_crl_import fails)
#
# Let me look at what line numbers the second loop starts at and what conditions are needed

# Let me look at how gnutls_pkcs12_simple_parse processes bags
import subprocess
result = subprocess.run(['grep', '-n', 'privkey_ok\|BAG_PKCS8_KEY\|BAG_CRL\|gnutls_pkcs12_bag_get_type\|gnutls_pkcs12_bag_get_data\|crl_init\|crl_import\|crl_deinit\|goto done', 
                       '/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/gnutls/lib/x509/pkcs12.c'],
                      capture_output=True, text=True)
print(result.stdout)
